data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2024 the syndicate carried gross claims outstanding of GBP 912.625m. During 2024 there was a net favourable prioryear movement in gross claims reserves of GBP 30.298m (a release of ~3.3% of opening reserves), disclosed as "Change in estimates of prior year provisions (30,298)". The year saw higher gross claims from specific events (notably Baltimore Bridge and hurricanes Helene and Milton) but much of this was recoverable through reinsurance; conversely there was adverse development related to exposures from the war in Ukraine (noted as affecting the 2021 year of account). Overall the technical provisions movement reported a net gross release, while specific lines (property/marine and reinsurance specialty exposures) experienced mixed adverse development.
